verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents first-party webhooks across several products: wallet webhooks for real-time events such as transfers and signer exports, payments/checkout webhooks for order lifecycle and payment status, and authentication webhooks for user-related events. However, its agent-native Agent Checkouts product explicitly ships with "no webhooks in v1" and requires polling, which is a notable gap for an AI-native persona. missing for 10: webhooks for agent checkouts (polling-only in v1), documented detail on endpoint registration and signature verification, independent or hands-on corroboration
